senses.gloss: m. (papilio) pavilion, tent, curtain. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 2ᵃ עשו לה פ׳ … בתוך פ׳ Ar. (ed. פָּאפִילְיוֹן) make a tent for her (my daughter), and I shall speak to her in the tent; Cant. R. to III, 9 פָּפִלְיוֹן; Yalk. Ex. 365 אפוליון (corr. acc.; Yalk. Cant. 986 קִיטוֹן).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 735:1">Yalk. Ps. 735</cite> <he>נטל פיפילון ופירש עליו</he> (corr. acc.) he took a curtain and spread it over him (David’s body); <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 3">Ruth R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <cite ref="Q00790"><he>פיפקין</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 650:1">Yalk. Ps. 650</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 10:11">Ps. X, 11</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Job 22:14">Job XXII, 14</cite>) <he>הדיין הזה משהן נותנין פסליון לפניו וכ׳</he> (read: <he>מותחין פפ׳</he>) when they spread the curtain before him, the judge no longer sees what is going on; Midr. Till. ed. Bub. to Ps. l. c. <he>נותנין פליטין</he> (corr. acc.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>, beg. <he>מותחין כילה</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, beg. <he>הוילון</he>).—Pl. <he>פָּפִילְיוֹנוֹת</he> (f.), <he>פָּפִילְיוֹנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:6:2">Y. Erub. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>פ׳ מגיעות עד הקורות</he> curtains reaching to the ceiling. Y’lamd. to Num. XI, 16 quot. in Ar. <he>אנו עושין לך פ׳ וכ׳</he> we will make thee curtains, and none shall see thee.
